name: oasis-asset-pipeline
prerequisites: Available authoring tool, original asset, actual consumer rig/axis/texture contract and output ownership. Tool-guided execution is supported; no generic autorig executable is bundled.

scenarios.trigger: Rounded disconnected patches tear under rigid weighting
scenarios.expected: Use topology-aware boundary blending and repeat the motion proof.

scenarios.trigger: T-pose asset has no armature or unweighted vertices
scenarios.expected: Do not claim rig readiness or conceal it with runtime filler.

scenarios.trigger: Preview validates but installed app loads an older asset
scenarios.expected: Compare staged hash and producer step; keep live verification open.
